name: Idol
description: A young adult pop singer with a slight but full-scale, spring-loaded build and a bright professional performance presence. Slight but unmistakably adult and full-scale, light, grounded and spring-loaded with soft knees; never childlike or doll-proportioned. Her recognition cues are two clearly separate ponytails attached to opposite sides of the head, a fitted cropped jacket, a short skirt, dark dance boots, empty hands, and a headset boom, all readable without facial detail; the ponytails never merge into one hair mass and no headwear is present. She wears a bone-coloured fitted cropped performance jacket with gold trim and a dark separating band inside the black outline, a coordinated short skirt, and dark dance boots. She holds no handheld prop: both hands stay visibly open and empty, and a small headset boom ends at the corner of her mouth. Her ready stance is light and grounded with soft knees, readable staggered feet, two open empty hands, and asymmetrical arms prepared for choreography. Palette, as base/shadow/highlight per material: dark #20232B / #101217 / #3A3E48; white #F1EEE5 / #BDB9AE / #FFFFFF; metal #6F747C / #34383E / #B5BAC0; bone #E6E4DE / #A9A79F / #FFFFFF; gold #C6A13A / #745A18 / #F0D36A; separator #34303A / #17141B / #57515F; skin #D39A76 / #8A5D45 / #F0BD98; hair #342A3F / #17121D / #67557A. Never draw: handheld microphone, stand, or cable; merged ponytails; childlike proportions; school uniform; brand marks; magical-girl effects; closed prop-holding fist.

animations.dance: Bright pop dance loop: make two light grounded steps with springy knees, alternate the two open empty hands in a clear choreographic phrase, let both separate ponytails follow, then return cleanly to frame 0. microphone does not need to be pointed at face and microphone arm is free to move
animations.sing: Headset vocal loop: keep both hands visibly open, use small asymmetric pop choreography around a held note, breathe through the shoulders, then recover to the light grounded stance. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop so she unmistakably reads as singing.
animations.flinch: Brief room-sound surprise: the ponytails and open hands react upward, the body recoils slightly, then she resets into a bright composed dance-ready pose. No opponent or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot stage self-protection: draw both open empty hands into a compact protective shape, keep the headset unobstructed, then hold a balanced grounded final stance. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: take light springy steps into frame, greet the room with both open hands, let the ponytails trail, then settle into the canonical choreography-ready stance.
animations.victory: One-shot performance finish: make a bright two-hand acknowledgement, let the separate ponytails settle, then hold a balanced professional pop-idol final pose.
animations.ko: Non-contact performance exhaustion: the springy posture softens through the knees and she settles safely into a low final hold with both hands open. Do not imply injury, impact, or an opponent.
